|game_text=If your Lobot on Cloud City, or your aliens occupy 3 Cloud City sites, look at the top 3 cards of your Reserve Deck. Take any or all of them into hand, and replace the others in any order.
|errata_history=Versions of [[Computer Interface (V)]] in [[Virtual Set 6: City In The Clouds]], in date order (3 versions). Slip texts are quoted as printed: ▼ and ▲ are the slips' arrow icons (deploy from / take into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle), and the immunity and pilot icons are the ones explained in each sheet's icon key (see [[Virtual card icons]]). Found while adding the original pre-Remaster slips (Bill, 12 November 2026).
* '''Original''' (this page): the “Final Revised Virtual Set 6” sheet “Virtual Set #6” (Players Committee; announced and tournament-legal 12 January 2004; PDF dated 12 January 2004), page 1, slip 7 — [https://web.archive.org/web/20040619231451/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Resources/AbsolutelyFinalVersion6.pdf AbsolutelyFinalVersion6.pdf on swccgpc.com] (Internet Archive capture of 19 June 2004; the Committee still hosts the same file as [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards6.pdf VirtualCards6.pdf] on res.starwarsccg.org), announced on the [https://web.archive.org/web/20040415220046/http://swccgpc.com/interior.htm Committee's news page]: “If your Lobot on Cloud City, or your aliens occupy 3 Cloud City sites, look at the top 3 cards of your Reserve Deck. Take any or all of them into hand, and replace the others in any order.” This is the earliest surviving slip: the first release sheet of 21 November 2003 is not preserved. The slip is the old pre-template slip the Committee used before its December 2006 Remaster: the Decipher-style lower half with the slip mark “6•7” at bottom right and no expansion icon.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Computer Interface (V) (Virtual Set 6) (Errata)]]): the updated sheet of 12 October 2004 ([https://web.archive.org/web/20050406053829/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Resources/Virtual%20Set%206.pdf Virtual Set 6.pdf] on swccgpc.com, Internet Archive 6 April 2005; PDF dated 12 October 2004; listed on the Committee's Virtual Cards page as “Revised 10/12/2004”), page 1, slip 7, on the same old slip: “Twice per turn, if your Lobot on Cloud City or your aliens occupy 3 Cloud City sites, look at the top 3 cards of your Reserve Deck. Take any or all of them into hand, and replace the others in any order.” '''What changed:''' “If” became “Twice per turn, if”; “City,” became “City”. The slip mark at bottom right now reads “6•7a” (the January sheet: “6•7”).
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Computer Interface (V) (Virtual Set 6) (Errata 2)]]): the Remaster sheet (official text as of 4 December 2006; [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024154341/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards6.pdf Internet Archive capture of 24 October 2007], slip 7), in the Committee's Remaster template: “Twice per turn, if your Lobot on Cloud City or you occupy three Cloud City sites with aliens, peek at the top three cards of your Reserve Deck. Take any of them into hand and replace the others in any order.” '''What changed:''' the Remaster rewrote the slip in the Committee's later wording (full text above; icons written out in words here). This is the current text of the Virtual Original card.
